name: Tryonixs Virtual Try-On for Eyewear Stores
author: Tryonixs

sections.description:
Tryonixs Virtual Try-On for Eyewear Stores

Online shoppers cannot walk into a store and try on frames. That uncertainty leads to hesitation, abandoned carts, and higher return rates for eyewear brands.

Tryonixs brings AI-powered AR shopping to your online store. Customers open their camera, try glasses and sunglasses virtually, and buy with confidence — all without leaving your product page.

This plugin connects online eyewear stores with Tryonixs AI Virtual Try-On technology. A Tryonixs account is required to activate the service.

Features

AI Eyewear Virtual Try-On
Customers can instantly try glasses and sunglasses using their device camera with realistic AR placement.

Online Store Integration
Works directly on product pages, shop archives, and shortcode placements.

Product-Level Control
Enable or disable try-on per product. Optionally set a Tryonixs product ID, transparent frame PNG, and frame measurements.

Mobile Optimized
Designed for mobile browsers where most eyewear shoppers browse and convert.

Easy Setup
Connect your Tryonixs account with a public API key — no custom coding required.

Conversion Optimization
Help customers visualize fit before purchase and reduce returns caused by “it doesn’t look right on me.”

How It Works

Step 1 — Create a Tryonixs Account
Visit https://tryonixs.com and create your account.

Step 2 — Copy Your Public API Key
Copy your public key in the format pk_live_xxxxxxxxx.

Step 3 — Connect Your Store
Paste the API key in Tryonixs → Dashboard.

Step 4 — Enable Virtual Try-On
Enable try-on on your eyewear products and publish. Customers will see a premium Try Virtual Try-On button near Add to Cart.

Shortcode

[eyewvitr_button id="123"]

Replace 123 with the WooCommerce product ID. Useful for page builders and custom layouts.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce (active)
  • A Tryonixs account with a public API key
  • Eyewear products with a featured image (or custom transparent frame PNG)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Complete the welcome setup (or go to Tryonixs → Dashboard).
  4. Enter your Public API Key from tryonixs.com.
  5. Open a WooCommerce eyewear product with a featured image and confirm the try-on button appears.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Tryonixs account?

Yes. This plugin connects WooCommerce to the Tryonixs AI Virtual Try-On service. Create an account at tryonixs.com.

Why is the try-on button not showing?

  1. API key saved under Tryonixs → Dashboard
  2. WooCommerce is active
  3. Product is published with a featured image (or custom frame PNG)
  4. Virtual Try-On is enabled on the product
  5. For page builders, use [eyewvitr_button id="PRODUCT_ID"]

Does the customer need a mobile app?

No. Virtual try-on runs in the browser. Camera permission is requested when the session starts.

Can I control which products show try-on?

Yes. Use the Tryonixs Virtual Try-On panel on each product to enable/disable try-on, set a product ID, frame image, and optional frame measurements.
